problem: A fixed current+8 policy can conservatively include up to 72.8% of current spatial objects by membership cardinality. Runtime IO latency, memory, draw cost and pop-in are unknown, so no prefetch policy is yet production-approved.
hero_residency_rule: Contextual L3-only overlay for the approaching/current hero core; L2 coverage never implies full-L2 residency.

P0_CURRENT_ONLY.role: minimum residency baseline / expected pop-risk control

P2_CURRENT_PLUS_8.warning: Do not promote merely because it is spatially conservative; current membership cardinality shows high residency pressure.

P3_DIRECTIONAL_ROUTE_WINDOW.role: previous/current/next route-cell window plus contextual L3 hero overlay
P3_DIRECTIONAL_ROUTE_WINDOW.reason: Lower conservative cardinality than current+8 while following authored travel direction. Must prove async-load lead time and reversal safety.

lead_time_experiment.principle: Choose prefetch lead from measured artifact load/residency latency and current travel speed; never hardcode a distance before latency is known.
lead_time_experiment.known_speed_truth: These are current prototype controller values, not a final Vela de Ceniza specification.
lead_time_experiment.promotion_rule: Required lead time must exceed measured p95/p99 load-to-ready latency with explicit safety margin defined by runtime owner.

required_runtime_measurements: resident object count and memory by cell/policy
selection_rule: Promote the least-resident policy that passes all visual/collision/traversal gates at required movement speeds and measured IO latency. If several pass, choose by measured performance/memory, not policy complexity alone.
truth: Experiment design only. No runtime policy is approved by this file.
